items.html: Correction 10 is the hairs that grow in the place of the beard near the beginning of the throat, and they grow from the bottom of correction 13; and the hairs of that Mazal of 13 lie over these and cover them, and these are correction 10. And they are not absorbed with them within both of them, like the hairs of correction 9; rather, they cover the throat, as mentioned in the Idra of Naso, page 134, side A, for the throat itself is the place of the Bina of AA, and there is no beard there, as above.
